title: CLCON/71/2010 of PREM CHAND Vs MANGA AND ORS

paras.text:
CLCON No. 71 of 2010
Hon'ble Tarun Agarwala, J.

Mr. Lalit Miglani, Advocate for the
applicant.
The applicant claims non-compliance of the
order dated 31st March, 2009 passed by the writ
court which arose out of injunction proceedings.
In my opinion, the applicant has a remedy of
moving an appropriate application before the writ
court under Order 39 Rule 2-A of the C.P.C.
The contempt application is dismissed on
the ground of alternative remedy.
 (Tarun Agarwala, J.)
Dated 03.06.2010
Shiv
